theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_massOn_ball_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → ∀ y ∈ C.support, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → unitBallVolume 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ 2) ≤ C.massOn (ball y ρ)
